user.title: Moisture Loop
user.description: Create the Moisture Loop controller. Add irrigation zones afterwards with 'Add zone'.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one Moisture Loop controller is supported.

user.title: Zone identity
user.description: Name the zone and select its soil-moisture sensor and irrigation actuator. {shared_sensor_warning}

thresholds.title: Thresholds and timing
thresholds.description: A new automatic session starts strictly below the start threshold and completes at or above the target. Every pulse is followed by the full soak before a new reading can decide. {shared_sensor_warning}

limits.title: Safety limits
limits.description: Hard bounds for automatic and manual watering. {shared_sensor_warning}

reconfigure.title: Zone identity
reconfigure.description: Update the zone identity. Changing configuration safely terminates any active session first. {shared_sensor_warning}

error.duplicate_name: Another zone already uses this name (names are compared case-insensitively).
error.wrong_domain: Unsupported entity type for this field.
error.valve_features_missing: This valve does not support both open and close commands; position-only valves are not supported.
error.duplicate_actuator: Another zone already controls this actuator.
error.actuator_identity_conflict: This actuator conflicts with retained durable identity evidence. Restore or resolve the original actuator identity before continuing.
error.target_not_above_start: The target threshold must be strictly greater than the start threshold.
error.invalid_configuration: One or more values are outside their allowed ranges.

abort.reconfigure_successful: Zone updated. Any previously active session was safely terminated.

start_manual_watering.name: Start manual watering
start_manual_watering.description: Start an explicit, bounded manual watering session for one zone. The effective duration is clamped by the manual maximum, session maximum, and remaining daily budget.

stop_watering.name: Stop watering
stop_watering.description: Cooperatively stop the zone's active session. A no-op in inactive states.

evaluate_zone.name: Evaluate zone
evaluate_zone.description: Run a normal guarded automatic evaluation. Bypasses nothing.

clear_fault.name: Clear fault
clear_fault.description: Acknowledge/clear the zone's fault when its safety condition is resolved.

device_not_found.message: No device with this ID exists.

not_a_zone_device.message: The selected device is not a Moisture Loop zone.

entry_not_loaded.message: The Moisture Loop controller is not loaded.

zone_not_ready.message: The zone runtime is not ready.

invalid_duration.message: The requested duration must be a positive number of seconds.

session_active.message: A session is already active for this zone.

fault_blocks_manual.message: The active fault does not permit manual watering.

actuator_not_ready.message: The actuator is not available and proven off.

daily_budget_exhausted.message: The daily watering budget is exhausted.

water_resource_occupied.message: Another configured actuator is or may be flowing.

fault_not_clearable.message: The fault condition is not resolved or requires reconfiguration.

request_refused.message: The request was refused by the zone's safety guards.

zone_sensor_missing.title: Moisture sensor missing for {zone_name}
zone_sensor_missing.description: The configured soil-moisture sensor {entity_id} no longer exists. The zone is blocked until it is reconfigured with a valid sensor.

zone_actuator_missing.title: Irrigation actuator missing for {zone_name}
zone_actuator_missing.description: The configured irrigation actuator {entity_id} no longer exists. The zone is blocked until it is reconfigured, and any unresolved water-resource blocker is retained.

actuator_off_unconfirmed.title: Water may still be flowing in {zone_name}
actuator_off_unconfirmed.description: The irrigation actuator could not be proven OFF after repeated commands. Water may be flowing uncontrolled: check the valve physically. The fault can be acknowledged only after the actuator is observed OFF.

runtime_store_integrity_lost.title: Moisture Loop safety history lost
runtime_store_integrity_lost.description: The runtime safety store is missing, corrupt, or does not match this installation. All automatic and manual watering is blocked, today's budget is treated as exhausted, and acknowledgement is required after every actuator is proven OFF.
